name.ja: ピカちんキットS05 逆再生スパイパス＆イカスPセット
name.en: Pikachin KitS05 Reverse Playback Spy Pass & Ikasu P Set

description.ja: • 電子のパワーを秘めたピカちんキットＳがぞくぞく登場！
description.en: • Pikachin KitS, which has hidden electronic power, is now available!

description.ja: • 仲間と暗号のやりとりができるピカちんキットＳ！不思議な逆再生録音機でヒミツのメッセージを仲間に送れ！
description.en: • Pikachin KitS allows you to exchange codes with your friends! Send a secret message to your friends using a mysterious reverse playback recorder!

description.ja: • ＤＶＤプレイヤーのまきもどし機能がピラメキのカギだ！
description.en: • The DVD player's rewind function is the key to success!

description.ja: • ピカちんロボＳと合体するとボイスレコーダー機能の再生スピードが変更可能に！
description.en: • When combined with Pikachin Robo S, the playback speed of the voice recorder function can be changed!
